name: Winged Boots

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Fly
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: a Fly Speed of 30 ft for 1 hour.

summary: 4 charges, each an hour's flight at 30 ft; 1d4 come back at dawn.
text: These boots hold 4 charges. Wearing them, you can take a Magic action and spend 1 charge to gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are still in the air when the hour is up, you drift down 30 feet each round until you land. Each dawn they regain 1d4 spent charges.
